question: Should Gateway HTTP adopt the existing `gateway.trustedProxies` boundary for W3C trace-context continuation, limited to a new child request span and excluding WebSocket propagation?
rationale: The proposed feature lets a trusted network intermediary influence diagnostic trace lineage, so maintainers must explicitly accept the proxy-sanitization and trust-boundary contract before it becomes supported behavior.

options.title: Accept the HTTP-only boundary
options.body: Land the linked PR after it proves a trusted proxy removes client-supplied headers and injects only its own valid `traceparent`.

options.title: Require a narrower design
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for a revised proposal if maintainers want a separate allowlist, different span semantics, or a broader propagation design.

recommendation.title: Accept the HTTP-only boundary
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR after it proves a trusted proxy removes client-supplied headers and injects only its own valid `traceparent`.
